name: opencode-docs-v2
body:
`README.md` and `AGENTS.md` state the opencode 2.x dependency and the apg-release-to-opencode version pairing. `README.md` names opencode 2.x as the chat-plugin dependency, states that `apg init` installs the plugin into the opencode 2.x plugin discovery location under `~/.opencode/`, and keeps the restart-opencode-after-init note. `AGENTS.md` states the same install layout in its `apg init` and suite sections (the plugin directory under `~/.opencode/`, the shared lib, the seven distributed agents) and the `@opencode/plugin` dependency. Both documents state the pairing as the support window: the apg 0.21.x line supports opencode v1, and the apg 0.22.x line supports opencode v2, so each apg release line supports exactly one opencode major (`requirements.constraint.opencode-v2-support-window`).

Acceptance criteria: `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` name opencode 2.x and the `@opencode/plugin` dependency; both describe the `plugins/` install location under `~/.opencode/`; both state the apg-release-to-opencode pairing (the apg 0.21.x line supports opencode v1, the apg 0.22.x line supports opencode v2); the restart-opencode-after-init note survives.
